prompt: Which U.S. National Park was the first to be established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their only playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the team?
answer: **Gateway Arch National Park** was the first U.S. national park established after the Portland Trail Blazers’ 2014 first-round playoff-series victory over the Houston Rockets—their only series win with LaMarcus Aldridge. The park was designated on **February 22, 2018**.
